-- dim_date.sql


WITH date_spine AS (
    SELECT generate_series(DATE '2023-01-01', DATE '2026-12-31', INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS full_date
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(full_date, 'YYYYMMDD')::INT AS date_key,
    full_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM full_date)::SMALLINT AS calendar_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM full_date)::SMALLINT AS calendar_quarter,
    TO_CHAR(full_date, 'Month') AS month_name,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM full_date)::SMALLINT AS month_number,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM full_date)::SMALLINT AS day_of_month,
    TO_CHAR(full_date, 'Day') AS day_of_week_name,
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM full_date) IN (6, 7) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_weekend_flag
FROM date_spine

-- dim_sales_profile.sql


SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales_channel, customer_segment, payer_type, payment_method, promotion_code) AS sales_profile_sk,
    sales_channel,
    customer_segment,
    payer_type,
    payment_method,
    promotion_code,
    prescription_required_flag,
    return_flag
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        sales_channel,
        customer_segment,
        payer_type,
        payment_method,
        COALESCE(promotion_code, 'NO_PROMO') AS promotion_code,
        prescription_required_flag,
        return_flag
    FROM "dwh"."silver"."silver_pharmacy_sales"
) sub

-- dim_facility.sql


WITH all_facilities AS (
    -- Commercial Pharmacies from Sales
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pharmacy_id AS facility_id,
        pharmacy_name AS facility_name,
        pharmacy_type AS facility_type,
        city,
        state
    FROM "dwh"."silver"."silver_pharmacy_sales"
    
    UNION
    
    -- Hospital Facilities from Demand
    SELECT DISTINCT
        hospital_id AS facility_id,
        hospital_name AS facility_name,
        hospital_type AS facility_type,
        city,
        state
    FROM "dwh"."silver"."silver_hospital_demand"
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY facility_id) AS facility_sk,
    facility_id,
    facility_name,
    facility_type,
    city,
    state,
    CASE 
        WHEN state IN ('NY', 'PA', 'MA', 'NJ') THEN 'Northeast'
        WHEN state IN ('IL', 'OH', 'MI', 'IN') THEN 'Midwest'
        WHEN state IN ('TX', 'FL', 'GA', 'NC') THEN 'South'
        ELSE 'West'
    END AS region
FROM all_facilities

-- fact_demand.sql


SELECT
    dem.demand_record_id,
    d.date_key,
    m.medicine_sk,
    f.facility_sk,
    dem.forecast_demand_packs,
    dem.requested_quantity_packs,
    dem.approved_quantity_packs,
    dem.received_quantity_packs,
    dem.consumed_quantity_packs,
    dem.unfulfilled_demand_packs,
    dem.stockout_days,
    dem.request_status
FROM "dwh"."silver"."silver_hospital_demand" dem
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_date" d 
  ON d.date_key = TO_CHAR(dem.demand_month, 'YYYYMMDD')::INT
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_medicine" m 
  ON dem.medicine_id = m.medicine_id 
 AND dem.demand_month >= m.effective_start_date 
 AND dem.demand_month < m.effective_end_date
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_facility" f 
  ON dem.hospital_pharmacy_id = f.facility_id

-- fact_pharm_sales.sql


SELECT
    s.sales_transaction_id,
    d.date_key,
    m.medicine_sk,
    f.facility_sk,
    w.warehouse_sk,
    sp.sales_profile_sk,
    s.warehouse_lot_id,
    s.production_batch_id,
    s.quantity_sold_packs,
    s.unit_retail_price_usd,
    s.gross_sales_amount_usd,
    s.discount_amount_usd,
    s.net_sales_amount_usd,
    s.sales_tax_usd,
    s.cost_of_goods_sold_usd,
    s.gross_margin_usd,
    s.returned_quantity_packs,
    s.days_to_expiry_at_sale
FROM "dwh"."silver"."silver_pharmacy_sales" s
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_date" d 
  ON d.date_key = TO_CHAR(s.sales_date, 'YYYYMMDD')::INT
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_medicine" m 
  ON s.medicine_id = m.medicine_id 
 AND s.sales_date >= m.effective_start_date 
 AND s.sales_date < m.effective_end_date
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_facility" f 
  ON s.pharmacy_id = f.facility_id
LEFT JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_warehouse" w 
  ON s.source_warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
JOIN "dwh"."gold"."dim_sales_profile" sp
  ON s.sales_channel = sp.sales_channel
 AND s.customer_segment = sp.customer_segment
 AND s.payer_type = sp.payer_type
 AND s.payment_method = sp.payment_method
 AND COALESCE(s.promotion_code, 'NO_PROMO') = sp.promotion_code
 AND s.prescription_required_flag = sp.prescription_required_flag
 AND s.return_flag = sp.return_flag
